responsibility: This module is the GCC target backend for the Xstormy16/Stormy16 architecture, responsible for turning GCC’s generic RTL and ABI operations into Stormy16-specific code generation, assembly syntax, and target behavior. Its core is the architectural description split between stormy16.h, which defines the machine’s ABI, data layout, register classes, stack and calling convention properties, and stormy16.md, which provides the RTL instruction patterns, expanders, peepholes, and instruction attributes used for instruction selection and assembly output. The accompanying stormy16.c/cc implementation supplies the executable target hooks and helper routines behind those patterns and macros, covering prologue/epilogue and frame layout, argument and return handling, address legitimacy, reload and reorg adjustments, cost modeling, branch and switch expansion, builtins, trampolines, and assembler/section emission. Supporting predicates.md and constraints.md define the target-specific operand recognizers and machine constraints that let the machine description match legal Stormy16 registers, immediates, memory forms, and carry- or bit-oriented instruction shapes, while stormy16.opt and its URLs file declare the backend’s command-line target option support. Together, these files form the complete machine-dependent code-generation layer that distinguishes the Stormy16 port from neighboring GCC backends.
